articles.title: Poll shows nearly 90% of Americans believe government corruption is widespread - The Washington Post
articles.description: Americans have the highest level of distrust in their government in two decades, voicing bipartisan frustration with the country's institutions and the people who run them.
articles.content:
A record number of Americans believe there is widespread corruption in the U.S. government, reaching the highest level of distrust in two decades, according to a Gallup poll released Wednesday.
